component.name: Madí
component.summary: Model, Align & Diagram Interconnects — Homage to Arte Madí (1946)

description.p: Madí (mah-DEE) is a professional schematic and technical diagram viewport engine named in homage to Arte Madí (Buenos Aires, 1946), famous for polygon frames (marco recortado), linear grids, and articulated spatial structures.

ul.li: Autonomous orthogonal Manhattan routing with dynamic bridge crossings
Hierarchical multi-level schematics with drill-down and symbol generation
Comprehensive shape stencil library with Boolean geometry operations and parametric controls
Customizable themes with high-contrast, dark, and light modes
Standard RFC 8259 JSON (.madi) serialization with JSONC comment support and bidirectional Draw.io XML
